name: MeshCentral
description: A fully open-source, self-hosted remote monitoring and management platform — a 100% web-based console with no client software needed on the admin side, plus built-in RBAC, 2FA, and MSP-grade fleet management, all free forever since you host it yourself.

Wayland Unattended Access.comment: Confirmed by the developers: full unattended access requires falling back to X11/XWayland; Wayland's security model otherwise requires user interaction

P2P (Direct Connection).comment: Architecture is hub-and-spoke: both the agent and the browser console connect out to your MeshCentral server, rather than connecting directly to each other

Relay Server.comment: This is the core of how MeshCentral works — but note it's your own self-hosted server acting as the relay, not a vendor-run cloud relay

Tailscale Support.comment: No native integration found; can likely be layered on top manually since agents just need network reachability to the server

Open Source.comment: Apache-2.0 license, fully open source since its first public release

Audio Streaming.comment: Remote audio playback from the managed device is supported

Adaptive Bitrate.comment: Remote desktop scaling/optimization exists (e.g. improvements shipped for the Android agent), but not a fully documented adaptive-bitrate video pipeline

H.264 Codec.comment: MeshCentral's remote desktop is a lightweight custom tile-update protocol, not H.264/video-codec based

Frame Rate (FPS).comment: Uses a custom tile/differential-update desktop protocol rather than fixed-FPS video streaming; no published number

Session Recording.comment: Remote desktop sessions can be recorded to file for later review

ISO Mounting.comment: Not a virtualization/KVM tool; no virtual media mounting

Pre-Login Access.comment: The native agent runs as a system service and can reach the machine before Windows login, similar to other agent-based tools

No Account Required.comment: The end user being helped doesn't need an account (ad-hoc session links can be generated), but the administrator/technician does need a MeshCentral account on the server

KVM Integration.comment: The "local device group" feature can relay to agent-less devices over SSH/RDP/VNC — MeshCentral's own documentation cites this being used to reach Raritan IP-KVM switch ports remotely

Shared Clipboard.comment: An automatic clipboard feature was added, plus clipboard support in the web-based RDP client

SSO / OIDC.comment: Supports SAML-based SSO and LDAP/Active Directory integration for enterprise authentication

2FA / MFA.comment: Extensive options: TOTP apps, WebAuthn/FIDO2 hardware keys, Yubikey OTP, email codes, Duo (paid third-party service), and passwordless LoginKey 3FA

Address Book.comment: Device groups ("meshes") serve as the organizational/address-book layer for managed machines

Audit Logs.comment: Built-in event logging for server and session activity

Mass Deployment.comment: Generates installable agent packages per device group for fleet rollout (MSI, scripts, etc.)

RBAC.comment: Granular role-based access control across users, user groups, and device groups

Remote Printing.comment: No dedicated virtual print driver documented

Generic USB Passthrough.comment: No native low-level USB redirection protocol

File Manager UI.comment: A remote file access/management interface is built into the web console

Text Chat.comment: Built-in chat and on-screen notifications for communicating with the end user during a session

OTA Updates.comment: The server can push agent updates to managed devices automatically

Windows: Client.comment: Fully web-based; any modern browser works

Linux Wayland: Host.comment: The agent connects and basic functions work, but full unattended remote desktop control currently needs XWayland/X11 fallback

Android: Host.comment: A dedicated MeshCentral Agent for Android exists

Web Browser: Client.comment: The web console is the primary and only official client — no separate desktop app to install for the admin

NVIDIA RTX 4090.comment: MeshCentral is an MSP/admin tool, not a GPU-accelerated game/3D streaming client — no GPU-dependent benchmark applies

Free Tier.comment: Completely free and open source; there is no official paid tier from the project itself since you self-host it

Enterprise.comment: No official enterprise SKU; some third-party providers sell managed/hosted MeshCentral instances, but that's not an official paid tier of the project
